issues.missing-key: Add the required API key in the environment where this connection runs, restart it, and test again.
issues.missing-cli: Install the required local app, make sure its command is on PATH, and test again.
issues.signed-out: Sign in to the local app with the required subscription account, then test again.
issues.wrong-auth-method: Sign out of the API-key session and sign back in with the required subscription account.
issues.credentials-rejected: Replace or renew the key in the same environment where this connection runs, restart it, and test again.
issues.wrong-key-type: Create an inference key that can run models; management and provisioning keys are not accepted.
issues.quota-exhausted: Increase the provider's spending limit or add credits, then test the same connection again.
issues.rate-limited: Wait for the provider's rate-limit window to clear, then test again without changing connections.
issues.timeout: Check network access from the execution environment, then retry the connection test.
issues.network: Check DNS, proxy, firewall, and outbound HTTPS access where this connection runs, then retry.
issues.service-error: The provider returned a temporary service error. Check its status page and retry shortly.
